会发现：止损宽的交易，仓位自然就该小；止损近的交易才能放大点仓位。

translatedData.title: Where Should You Place Your Stop-Loss? How I Choose Between Technical Levels and Percentages
translatedData.subTitle:
Where you place your stop-loss matters more than whether you set one. Too close, and you’ll get stopped out every day; too far, and one loss can hurt badly.

【Fixed-Percentage Method】For example, exit whenever you lose 1%–2% of your capital. It’s simple and straightforward, making it suitable for beginners
and helps build discipline. The downside is that it ignores market structure, so your stop might end up right where everyone else’s stops are clustered.

【Technical-Level Stop-Loss Method】Place it where the setup is invalidated: below key support for a long position, and
above resistance for a short position. The logic is: if price breaks this level, that’s evidence I was wrong.
Adjust your position size accordingly: the wider the stop, the smaller the position, so the loss on any single trade remains

披露信息显示，涉事股份约445.39万股B轮股份，原由曾与FTX体系有关联的Caroline Ellison和Nishad Singh持有。两人于2022年参与Anthropic早期投资；FTX崩盘后，法院将相关股份认定为可没收资产，美国政府随后完成接管。美国政府以每股140.9676美元的价格将股份出售给Anthropic，Anthropic再以相同价格转售给9名身份未公开的买家。

这笔交易的关键不在于普通意义上的股权退出，而在于被没收资产如何回流受害方。报道显示，司法部在2025年底向相关账户划转约6.38亿美元，金额与售股所得存在小幅差异，或与结算、账户划转等环节有关；可明确的是，处置所得被纳入FTX破产财产，并服务于债权人赔付。对于长期受FTX事件影响的债权人而言，资产追缴和变现是清偿链条中的实际补充。

When I first entered crypto, I had just 1,200 USDT too. My hands were shaking the first time I placed an order. But I knew one thing for sure: the smaller your starting capital, the less you can afford to rush.

Another was for swing trades: I entered only when the signals were clear, focusing on high-probability setups. The last part was my reserve, and I never touched it. Second: Follow the trend; don’t waste your time in choppy markets. The market moves sideways most of the time. If there’s no clear direction, just watch. Reap announced on October 26 that it had integrated the Monad blockchain into its stablecoin payment network, primarily to serve financial applications in Latin America. But a closer look at Monad’s background reveals that the company was recently exposed for having its stablecoin reserves evaporate. translatedData.subTitle:
There’s one term you can’t avoid when trading perpetual contracts: the funding rate. Settled every 8 hours, it’s a payment between longs and shorts
—the exchange simply collects and pays it out; it doesn’t make money from it.

[Mechanism] Perpetual contracts have no expiry date, so how does their price stay in line with the spot price? The answer is the funding rate:
When the contract price is above the spot price (strong bullish sentiment) → the funding rate is positive → longs pay shorts;
When the contract price is below the spot price (bears have the upper hand) → the funding rate is negative → shorts pay longs.
The money shifts between the two sides, pulling the contract price toward the spot price.
